name: Commission for the Arts
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts
AGENDA
FEBRUARY 1, 2016 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the Commission Secretary. If at least two Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
4.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
5.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES OF THE JANUARY 4, 2016 MEETING.
Approve the Minutes.
6.
ACTION ITEMS - OLD BUSINESS
6A.
None.
7.
ACTION ITEMS - NEW BUSINESS
7A.
Proposal by Jeffrey Laudenslager for the Loan of Public Art and a Privately Funded Sculpture Pad at K Street Pocket Park. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
Appoint Public Art Advisory Committee to research the proposal and bring a recommendation to the Commission.
7B.
Public Art Advisory Committee Recommendations for Public Art at the Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center, Marine Garage and Concession Building. Contact Person: Commissioner Sabeck.
Vote on recommendations and present to the City Council for their consideration.
7C.
Nominate and Appoint a Commissioner to serve as Vice Chairman of the Commission for the Arts. Contact Person: Chair Thum
Receive nominations, vote on the appointment.
7D.
Approve the 2016/17 Commission for the Arts Meeting Dates. Contact Person: Chair Thum
Vote to approve.
8.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
8A.
Arts Education Ad Hoc Report. Contact Person: Commissioner Stefanko.
8B.
Film Festival Ad Hoc Report. Contact Person: Commissioner Filsinger.
8C.
Encinitas Friends of the Arts Report. Contact Person: Commissioner Tanha.
8D.
Pacific View Activation Plan Report. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
8E.
Public Art Ad Hoc Report: Marine Safety Center. Contact Person: Commissioner Sabeck.
8F.
Music by the Sea Report. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
8G.
Commission-sponsored and Co-sponsored Events:
Visual art receptions: Tom Leedy, Friday, February 6, 5-7pm. Civic Center Gallery
Sherry Jodallian, Saturday, February 7, 1-4pm. Encinitas Comm. Center Gallery
Wednesdays@Noon concerts: February 3, 10, 17, 24, Encinitas Library.
Music by the Sea concert: February 19, Encinitas Library.
9.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
10.
COMMISSIONERS' REPORTS
11.
ARTS ADMINISTRATOR REPORT
12.
ADJOURNMENT
